# The whole software lifecycle, with the gates that refuse to skip steps.
$ init --name "Invoice tracker" --summary "Track invoices"
$ status
$ init
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "All good"
> printf '# Review\n\nAll good.\n' > review.md
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "All good"
$ review add --phase 1 --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Wrong phase"
> for k in functional architecture stack security; do printf '# %s\n\nWritten.\n' $k > .lacarta/specs/$k.md; done
$ status
$ spec submit functional
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "All good"
$ phase add --title "Core" --goal "Invoices can be created" --scope "API" --scope "Storage" --covers FR-1 --covers SR-1
$ phase add --title "Screens" --goal "Invoices are usable from a browser"
$ ask --title "Which database?" --option "Postgres|Robust, needs a server" --option "SQLite|One file" --spec stack
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "All good"
$ answer Q-1 --choice MySQL
$ answer Q-1 --choice SQLite --comment "keep it simple"
$ wait Q-1
$ answer Q-1 --choice SQLite
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "All good"
$ status
$ spec submit functional
$ spec submit functional
$ spec submit architecture --note "Look at the data flows."
$ spec submit stack
$ spec submit security
$ plan submit
$ phase add --title "Late" --goal "Too late"
$ answer Q-2 --choice Approve
$ answer Q-3 --choice Approve --comment "fine"
$ answer Q-4 --comment "free text is not allowed here"
$ answer Q-4 --choice Approve
$ answer Q-5 --choice Approve
$ status
$ answer Q-6 --choice Approve
$ status
$ phase start 2
$ phase start 1
$ phase start 1
$ agent start --role security_review --task "Review phase 1" --phase 1
$ --agent A-2 finding add --phase 1 --review security --severity high --title "SQL injection in search"
$ --agent A-2 finding add --phase 1 --review security --severity high --title "SQL injection in search" --detail "The query is built with string formatting." --location app/search.py:12 --scenario "q=' OR 1=1 -- returns every invoice" --recommendation "Use bound parameters"
$ --agent A-2 finding add --phase 1 --review security --severity low --title "Verbose error page"
$ phase complete 1
$ status
$ finding resolve F-1 --status accepted --note "fine"
$ finding resolve F-1 --status fixed --note "too early"
$ answer Q-7 --choice "Accept the risk"
$ answer Q-7 --choice "Fix it now"
$ wait Q-7
$ status
$ finding resolve F-1 --status fixed --note "Bound parameters; test_search_injection"
$ finding resolve F-1 --status fixed --note "again"
$ phase complete 1
$ review add --phase 1 --type functional --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Meets FR-1"
$ --agent A-2 review add --phase 1 --type security --verdict fail --report review.md --summary "F-2 open"
$ phase complete 1
$ --agent A-2 review add --phase 1 --type security --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Clean"
$ phase complete 1
$ finding resolve F-2 --status wont-fix --note "Errors are generic in production"
$ agent done A-2 --summary "Phase 1 reviewed"
$ agent done A-2
$ --agent A-2 ask --title "Too late"
$ phase complete 1 --summary "Invoices can be created through the API."
$ answer Q-8 --choice "Request changes" --comment "Add pagination"
$ status
$ phase complete 1 --summary "With pagination."
$ answer Q-9 --choice Approve
$ final start
$ phase start 2
$ review add --phase 2 --type functional --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "ok"
$ review add --phase 2 --type security --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "ok"
$ phase complete 2
$ answer Q-10 --choice Approve
$ status
$ final complete
$ final start
$ final complete
$ review add --phase final --type functional --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Matches the specs"
$ review add --phase final --type security --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "No findings"
$ final complete --summary "Both passed."
$ status
$ answer Q-11 --choice Approve
$ status
$ decide --title "Keep SQLite for v1" --decision "SQLite" --rationale "One user" --phase 1
$ decisions
$ agent list
$ agent rename A-2 --name Jerry
$ agent rename A-2 --name Bea
$ agent update A-1 --task "Wrapping up" --status idle
$ agent list
$ reply Q-1 --message "too late"
$ wait
$ wait Q-99
$ models
$ models --json
$ models --set security_review=haiku
$ models --set security_review=gpt
